## Functions

### `planParticleKinematicsSpatialPages(input, options = {})`

Morton-cluster particles before page construction. Unsafe candidate pages are split along their longest spatial axis until safe or until the configured minimum size/depth is reached; an irreducible unsafe page remains present with explicit canonical-raw fallback ownership.
